preconditions.description: The number of houses in the village is an integer greater than 1 and less than or equal to 10^5.
Each road connects two houses where the house numbers are between 1 and N.
No road connects a house to itself.
The total number of roads in the village is N-1.

postconditions.description: The output length is a non-negative integer representing the smallest total length of the shortest paths in kilometers.
The output assignment is a list of N house numbers representing the new houses where the villagers should move.

postconditions.expression: all(v_i != i for v_i in output_assignment)
postconditions.description: Each villager moves to a new house that is different from their original house.

postconditions.expression: exists valid_assignment such that sum(shortest_paths(i, valid_assignment[i]) for i in range(N)) == output_length
postconditions.description: There exists a valid assignment where the sum of the shortest paths from the original house to the new house for all villagers is minimized.
